description: Provincial Waterways Lines is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Manitoba | Gouvernement du Manitoba. This line dataset was created to provide a record of the designated Provincial Waterways in Manitoba. This database contains lines showing the locations of provincial waterways, such as drains, diversions, detention basins, floodways, dams and reservoirs. Coverage: Government of Manitoba. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Manitoba | Gouvernement du Manitoba. Its tags are Reservoir, Information Technology Services Branch, Dike, Dam, Manitoba Infrastructure. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2025-02-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OpenMB Information and Data Use License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
